title: Matter of Light Cheat Sheet
eyebrow: Matter of Light · Director’s Bible · Anchorframe
lede: Every stage of making Matter of Light as a task, with its subtasks sorted by colour: the steps to do, the settings to use, and the lessons the film taught. Nine stages, five gates, one loop.
byline: B.L. Barkey · Higgsfield Global Film Festival 2026

phases.name: Before anything moves
phases.note: Writing, identities and stills. Images are cheap; every mistake fixed here saves a video.

phases.name: Making it move
phases.note: Timing, motion and sound. After Gate C, a structural change costs video, not images.

phases.name: Finishing and learning
phases.note: The cut, the submission, and the read of the delivered film against the board.

stages.name: Story
stages.q: What is the film about, and who changes?
stages.mol: Aug 8 – Sep 9 · 23 shots at 13.0s mean · 3 movements 80 / 118 / 102s · 12 lines, 89 words
steps: **Write the logline first.** One sentence, ≤140 characters, three variants.
**Cut the screenplay to shots at cinema length.** Mean 13s, not 4s sizzle. Motivate every cut by point of view, time or revelation.
**Cut the dialogue to what a synthetic voice can carry.** 556 words became 89.
**Name the turn.** The last held close-up belongs to whoever changes.
settings: **Runtime target** 300s, split into three movements.
**Silent shots** marked now: `audio: false` in the shot list.
**Shot list** lives in `project.json → shots[]`; dialogue in `design/dialogue.json`.
lessons: **A second sentence in the logline means a second film.**
**The ending was reversed on Sep 14.** Rewriting only the last two shots kept everything upstream.
**Check order and attribution against the source,** not just whether a beat is present.

loop.name: The ending
loop.when: the turn lands on the wrong character
loop.do: rewrite the last two shots only

stages.name: Cast
stages.q: Does every face, place and thing exist once, by id?
stages.mol: Done Sep 5 · 42 sheets · 37 handles · 5 Souls (4 active) · 4 plates · 3 boards
steps: **Write the rule sheets before any character.** Here, the aura rule and the attunement ladder.
**Train one Soul per lead,** then generate every state sheet from it. Never re-describe a face.
**One lighting plate per act,** plus one per exception, and one Canvas board per plate.
**Locations, props, creatures, effects on a plain background,** three views on one sheet where it helps.
**Record every id** and attach it as `@[name](uuid)` in every prompt from here on.
settings: **Sheets** on `nano_banana_2` or `nano_banana_pro`.
**Souls** on Soul Cast `soul_2`, budget 10–500. One Soul per generation; two-person shots run on elements.
**Generate inside the project folder.** The API cannot file it for you.
**`retired`** keeps old name → old id so old renders still attribute.
lessons: **Never describe a covering by what it is not.** The filter read the disclaimer as the subject: two credits and an hour.
**Record old → new the moment you swap an element.** Two swaps went unrecorded and four prompts pointed at dead ids.
**Scores cannot see a wrong face.** All four S5 takes carried the mortal sheet.
**File by what a thing is,** never by where it is used.

loop.name: Identity
loop.when: a face moved or a shot used a superseded sheet
loop.do: retire the old id, regenerate from the Soul, sweep every prompt

gate.name: Identity lock
gate.test: All sheets on one screen in the canvas. Look for a face that moved, and record the answer.

stages.name: Anchors
stages.q: Does the film exist as stills, in order, that are already right?
stages.mol: Skeleton Sep 6 · 39 anchors · 6 shared · 2 bridges · 3 match pairs
steps: **Make the first and last frame of every shot,** in film order, on the plate’s board. F01 should be almost nothing.
**Chain each frame from the previous frame’s job id,** not from its prompt.
**Make a shared frame once, a bridge truly black, a match pair as a pair.**
**Two passes on a prompt, then rewrite it.** Promote any draft that beats its anchor.
settings: **No text, no letters, no watermark,** said three ways in every prompt.
**Frame roles** in `design/anchor-plan.json`: single, shared, bridge, match.
lessons: **Drift here costs an image; drift later costs a video.**
**A bridge that is only 70% black** reads as a hidden cut that failed.
**The selection pass is where the time goes,** not the skeleton: one generation per frame took a day, choosing took a week.

loop.name: The frame
loop.when: a composition will not survive its duration
loop.do: two passes on the prompt, then rewrite

gate.name: String lock
gate.test: Every frame on one contact sheet, read left to right twice. Anything that drifts is regenerated before a single video.

stages.name: Stills reel & timing
stages.q: Does it play, at length, before anything moves?
stages.mol: Planned Sep 9 · 300s target · 5:43 on the board · 6:17 delivered
steps: **Cut the stills at their durations and sit through the whole runtime.** Where attention drops, a shot is long or a cut is unmotivated.
**Decide the structure now:** linear, prologue splice, fold or interlace. Price each in new anchors.
**Freeze runtime, order and count,** and write the date down.
settings: **A structural fix moves an establishing beat,** not a scene: one new anchor at most.
**Song first.** If the sound might be a song, lock it here and cut the stills reel to it.
lessons: **The cut followed three songs’ lyrics.** The music-video rule applied and nobody noticed.
**A zero-cost fix was never applied.** The brothers’ beat was priced at one anchor; they first appear at 4:59.

loop.name: Structure
loop.when: the peak lands early or the lead dies before we meet the ending’s carrier

gate.name: Timing lock
gate.test: Runtime, order and count frozen. Any change after this is a re-render.

stages.name: Motion
stages.q: Is every shot a move between two frames that are already right?
stages.mol: Sep 13 big run, 43 renders · 51 v4.0 renders Sep 10–14 · 2 of 16 chained
steps: **Pull the project’s history before you spec a run.** Read what you are actually using.
**Run a cheap pass on every shot first,** then finals per act.
**Two takes per prompt, then rewrite.** A third take is a different prompt.
**Chain start and end frames on anything over 12s,** from the rendered last frame, not the anchor still.
**Score every take ≤16s.** Read the curve, not the number.
settings: **`cinematic_studio_video_4_0`** in the web app: 8–16s, 720p → 1080p, 21:9, renders 1344×576 at 720p.
**`minimax_h3`** is the one API model with two frames, audio references, 21:9 and `folder_id`.
**Audio off** on every shot marked silent, and on every regeneration of one.
**Cost** about 5 min and one credit per 16s take at 1080p. Scoring is free, two at a time.
lessons: **The notes said v2, 12s, 720p. The account said v4.0, 16s.**
**17 of 18 takes peaked on their last second,** so the hook score undersells a slow film.
**Regenerations with audio on invented lines** (“Thank you”, “I’m sorry.”) in silent shots.
**One generation per shot gave the editor one angle.** Plan coverage or montage before Gate D.

loop.name: The take
loop.when: an identity break, a missing beat or an outlier score
loop.do: regenerate only that, on the right sheet, then re-score and rebuild

gate.name: Motion lock
gate.test: A pick per shot, chained where it must be, no identity break in any pick.

stages.name: Voice & sound
stages.q: Is every sound in the project, and is every silence a decision?
stages.mol: Sep 13 · 12 lines · 40 takes · 4 per line · 0.1 credit each
steps: **Cast two voices per character on the same line;** pick one and write it down.
**Four takes per line** with the scene’s mood. Keep the spec take as take 1.
**Generate the voice first,** attach it as an audio reference, and turn the model’s own audio off on that shot.
**Upload every audio file into the project** and credit the music honestly on the end card.
settings: **`seed_audio`** 0.1 credit a line · speech rate −50 to 100 · pitch −12 to 12 · no seed.
**`qwen_audio_tts`** has a real seed and an instruction field; `text2speech_v2` is ElevenLabs via Higgsfield.
**Score** made in Suno’s app, then uploaded. There is no API.
lessons: **Sound was the weakest region in 13 of 18 clips.** Put the first line under the first three seconds.
**A silence rule cannot survive a lyric on the climax.** The vortex played under “In the sky!”.
**The opening narration existed** but was not under the black at submission.

loop.name: The read
loop.when: a line reads flat or the tempo is wrong for the shot
loop.do: one more take at ±12 speech rate, never more than four

stages.name: The cut
stages.q: Which take, in what order, and why?
stages.mol: Sep 14, 21:30–23:59 UTC · 22 picks · 21 favourites, 6 of them the board’s alternates
steps: **Decide the rhythm before you pick:** held frames, or montage to a song.
**Pick by look, break ties by score,** and write why under each pick.
**Keep the tail, trim the head.** 17 of 18 takes paid on their last second.
**Favourite the pick of every shot as you lay it.** It is the only record the platform keeps.
**Fix with edits before generations:** a split, a voice under black, a take swap.
settings: **Timeline at the film’s aspect before export:** 2560×1098 · 24 fps · H.264 CRF 17 · AAC 320.
**Deliver at native size ×2 at most.** 1344×576 blown to UHD is eight times the pixels and soft.
**End card:** generate the plate with no text, lay the type in the NLE, hold credits 12s or more.
lessons: **Selection is the grade.** On S22 the chroma take scored 59, the flat take 49.
**The board planned 23 shots at 13s; the cut ran 100 scenes at 3.7s.**
**The excluded dragon takes became the 23s set piece.** Show excluded takes greyed, never hidden.
**Five Orianes and two leviathans reached the cut.** Audit the timeline, not the board.

loop.name: The cut
loop.when: an arc, light or hook problem against the judges
loop.do: three changes, one per judge, priced in generations

gate.name: Picture lock
gate.test: No further generation. The export exists and plays end to end.

stages.name: Deliver
stages.mol: Sep 14–17 · final MOV ~23:30 UTC · 3 loglines · 3 support addresses
steps: **Read the rules again on the day,** and pass rights on every input: no real face or voice anywhere.
**Apply watermark and packshot through the platform’s own flow.** Never recreate them.
**Post publicly from a public account** and check both in a private window.
**Verify every generation is inside the project.** Submit. Then stop.
settings: **Minimal viable submission** has two parts: watermark and packshot, and the public post.
**Deadline in its own timezone.** Two records disagreed (UTC vs PT); work to the earlier one.
**Public page:** higgsfield.ai/@drawingsquid1334/projects/matter-of-light
lessons: **The submit flow put nine seconds of packshot at the head.** Check where it lands before the last export.
**The full film exists once in the account,** as the Sep 16 MOV. Record which file went where, by id and date.
**Ownership and exposure are different risks.** Ask what the submission publishes.

stages.name: Learn
stages.q: What did the cut change, and what does the next film inherit?
steps: **Upload the master into the project root** and keep the low proxy beside it.
**Start the scene analysis, then read favourites against picks** while it runs.
**Diff order, durations, swaps, trims, drops and additions.** Price each as an edit or a generation.
**Write each delta three ways:** a lesson, a reminder on the stage that could have caught it, an example.
settings: **`video_analysis_create` → `video_analysis_status`.** About an hour in the queue on a 6:17 film.
**The Predictor refuses anything over 16s,** and a 16s render is 16.05s. Score the 15s and 8s takes.
**`project.json → final`** records the master, exports, analyses and where the read lives.
lessons: **The cut overruled the board six times on look and never on score.**
**The analyser read adult swimmers as children.** The 18+ rule is a per-take check on wides.
**Of three last-hour changes,** one was applied, one half, one not.

loop.name: The read
loop.when: a finished film exists and the board disagrees with it
loop.do: scenes → diff → three rules, then start the next board from them

rows: @[name](uuid) for every face, place and thing
No text, no captions, no logos anywhere in frame
a described face, or a covering described negatively
dmn_mean, lower is better; 0.5 or less is good
keys.env only; never in a prompt or a commit
every sheet 18+; read every wide back
licence and visibility before the first push

bible.note: Lessons from keeping the Director’s Bible and the repository, not the picture.
lessons: **When one list drives another, audit them against each other on every change.** Parity drift is silent.
**Retire superseded work the moment its replacement exists.** Keeping both is a decision left for later.
**State what was verified and what was not,** in the document itself.
**When state looks wrong, diff against the remote before acting.** The fix was a fast-forward, not a new commit.
**Every rung of an escalation must take something as well as give.** If the ladder only goes up, the ending cannot land.
**Regenerate, don’t hand-edit.** Every page is a function of its data; if the page is wrong, the data is wrong.
